category_title: High-academic kindergartner with ASD who uses classroom scripts for social interaction
scenario_title: Transitioning to an unchallenging math worksheet
minimal_context: Jasmine is sitting at a round table with a peer and a paraprofessional to complete a math worksheet where she needs to color objects in groups of four.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to complete your math worksheet. Please color the objects on the page in groups of four.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Let’s do some colors! What color is the apple? What color is the boy? What color is the car?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jasmine, please look at your own paper. You need to do your math.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Excitedly shakes her braids and rubs her fingers together quickly in front of the ABC book) O the O says/ o/, octopus. the T says…

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: (Points to the math worksheet) You cannot read the ABC book right now. We have music next, so you need to do your math.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Grabs the ABC book again) No! Aaahh!
